prose: In the 1991 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the United Democratic Front (UDF) emerged largest with 92 seats, against 48 for the LDF. Turnout was 73.43% of 19,641,940 electors.
By vote share, the UDF polled 51.17% and the LDF 42.99%, with the NDA on 4.76%. A total of 809 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 1987, the UDF gained 31 seats (from 61 to 92); the LDF moved from 78 to 48. Power changed hands from the LDF.
The closest contest was Kovalam, won by George Mascrene (Cong-I) over A. Neelalohitadasan Nadar (J.D.) by just 23 votes. The largest margin was A. Yoonus Kunju in Malappuram (27,109 votes).
K. Karunakaran headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
